Card Q&A.q: This card has multiple effects that trigger when it digivolves or when it attacks. In what order can they be activated?
Can I use this card's 1st [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to place [Mineral] or [Rock] trait Digi-Egg cards from my trash in digivolution cards?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If this card's 1st [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect activates, you must place at least 1 card in digivolution cards. However, if you choose to not activate this effect, it won't activate and you don't place any cards in digivolution cards.

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't. The minimum value is 0, the resulting play cost can't be negative.
